gaps.sentence: Do come round ___ dinner next week.
gaps.explanation: come round = visit; come round FOR dinner/TO our place.

gaps.sentence: I can't put up ___ this noise any longer.
The doctors pulled him ___ after a difficult night.
gaps.explanation: pull through = recover from a serious illness.

gaps.sentence: Who will take ___ from the current director?
gaps.explanation: take over = take control of a job/company.

gaps.sentence: I had to turn ___ their invitation because I was ill.
gaps.explanation: turn down = reject an offer/invitation; turn up = appear.

gaps.sentence: She put her ideas ___ clearly and confidently.
gaps.explanation: put across = communicate an idea successfully.

gaps.sentence: It's hard to keep ___ with the latest slang.
gaps.explanation: keep up with = stay level with somebody/something changing.

gaps.sentence: Please could you look ___ my plants while I'm away?
